title: Get Your USCard
text:
Get Your USCard (USC ID card).

ELIGIBILITY AND RULES
- The USC ID is USC property, must be shown to university officials on request, and is not transferable. Use may be revoked for policy violations.
- You must be registered for the current academic semester, or be an active employee or affiliate, to hold an ID.
- You may not possess more than one ID.

FEES
- First USC ID: free for students, faculty, staff and affiliates.
- Replacement ID: $25.

HOW TO GET A FIRST ID (3 steps)
1. Fill out the USC ID Application online.
2. Securely upload your photo and a government- or state-issued photo ID.
3. Select your university affiliation: student, staff or faculty.
You will receive an email with your submission status.

PHOTO REQUIREMENTS
- Recent, front-view, color, unedited image (no app filters).
- Space between the top of your head and the top of the image.
- No hats or sunglasses.
- Maximum upload size 10MB.

REPLACEMENTS
- Requesting a replacement immediately terminates your existing associated services and transfers them to the new ID. Surrender the old ID at pickup if you have it. Old IDs cannot be reactivated once a replacement is processed.

PICKUP LOCATIONS AND HOURS (office hours Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm)
- University Park Campus: Customer Service Center, McCarthy Way Parking Structure, 620 McCarthy Way, Los Angeles, CA 90089-1336. Phone (213) 740-8709.
- Health Sciences Campus: One Stop at HSC, Seaver Residence Hall, 1969 Zonal Avenue, Los Angeles, CA 90033-9163. Phone (323) 442-2110.
- Email for both campuses: uscard@usc.edu.

NOTE: the page does not mention freezing a lost card.
